items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: And -- heck, what was the third sax man? Charlie Harris on sax.

ctx.x: He went to Phillips, yeah. And Jerome Carrington on piano. And Omer Simeon on clarinet and saxophone. And -- heck, what was the third sax man? Charlie Harris on sax. And what was Thomas' name on oboe? He was from the West Indies.
